serverAliasesStatus: protocol compatibility aliases only if required by host; OpenCode/DeepSeek is not an active provider
toolAliasesStatus: protocol compatibility aliases only if required by host; all route to canonical Antigravity+Gemini execution

packaging.packageNameStatus: historical compatibility identifier; unchanged because package-lock.json is outside this ownership

activeRoute.pointer: the route_state pointer is additive compatibility state and must resolve only to antigravity-flash-high
activeRoute.operatorControl: route list / route status / route set antigravity-flash-high via the authenticated loopback daemon
activeRoute.noRestart: route state changes do not require an Antigravity restart
activeRoute.offlineBehavior: route commands fail closed when the daemon is not ready and never write a competing pointer
activeRoute.noOverride: MCP spawn does not accept a provider/model override; stale or conflicting legacy values are rejected before side effects
activeRoute.noFallback: there is no provider, model, route, or timeout fallback

routes.modelRouteOnSpawn: not caller-selectable; every new spawn uses the active antigravity-flash-high route
routes.pinnedPerAgent: the selected Antigravity/Gemini route is persisted on new agents; in-flight agents do not change identity
routes.legacyCompatibility: old agents may retain historical flat provider/model fields and route labels for read-only history/recovery; those values never select a new provider and OpenCode/DeepSeek is not an active provider

errors.propagation: stable machine-readable codes flow through HTTP bodies and MCP structuredContent without text sniffing

contextFiles.prevalidation: containment, existence, regular readable file, and bounded size are validated before any workspace/process/job side effect
contextFiles.oversizedInput: rejected, never silently truncated or sent through another provider

visualContext.semantics: textual only; the orchestrator inspects visuals and sends direct observations, interpretation, and uncertainty; execution never receives untrusted pixels

antigravity.asyncContract: subagents_spawn returns an accepted pending obligation after job creation; agy runs asynchronously and subagents_follow observes completion, failure, approval, or abort

fallback.policy: timeouts, transport errors, unavailable executables, and invalid/ambiguous output remain terminal failures

antigravity.sandbox: antigravitySandbox is explicit and defaults to false
antigravity.command: antigravityCommand is one trusted executable name or absolute path; it is never a shell command line
antigravity.addDirs: only explicit absolute writable directories are accepted
antigravity.autoApprove: antigravityAutoApprovePermissions is explicit and independent of sandboxing
antigravity.recovery: after daemon loss, stranded active Antigravity jobs are terminalized with a clear failure reason; an orphaned child is not adopted
antigravity.secrets: the bridge never reads, writes, or exposes Antigravity credentials

obligations.consumption: terminal results become consumed when follow/recover returns a usable final result
obligations.agentCloseSeparate: closing the agent is separate from consuming the obligation
obligations.legacyContinuation: compatibility aliases continue to the same pinned Antigravity/Gemini identity and never reopen a historical provider

installer.processLifecycle: does not start or stop processes in this patch
installer.profileParameter: safe (default fast check) or full (deep quick_check)

history.providerStatus: OpenCode/DeepSeek is not an active provider; historical records are strictly read-only
history.preservation: SQLite, WAL/SHM, results, deliveries, inbox, spool, backups, logs, and old identifiers are preserved by default in read-only mode
history.migration: explicit only: prove quiescence, preserve the source, create and verify a size/SHA-256 manifest, validate restore, then change configuration
history.malformedRecords: partial, private, malformed, or ambiguous historical records fail closed and are never remapped into a new execution
